z-m-17-03.title: Ukugcwalisa isitsha esimise okwebhola, sidinga amanzi esitsha esimise okwekhoni izikhathi ezingaki?
z-m-17-03.topic: Ivolumu yebhola: ubudlelwano phakathi kwamavolumu ebhola, ikhoni, nesilinda
z-m-17-03.goal: Linganisela ubudlelwano phakathi kwamavolumu ebhola, ikhoni, nesilinda ngaphambi kokubala, lungisa ukulinganisela isikhathi ngasinye lapho umphumela wokulinganisa ufika bese uwuhlela ube yinani eliqondile, futhi linganisa ukuthi ivolumu iba nkulu izikhathi ezingaki uma ubude buphindwa kabili.
z-m-17-03.material: Kunesitsha esimise okwebhola A esinoradiyasi engu-3 cm, isitsha esimise okwekhoni B esinoradiyasi yesisekelo engu-3 cm nokuphakama okungu-6 cm, nesitsha esimise okwesilinda C esinoradiyasi yesisekelo engu-3 cm nokuphakama okungu-6 cm. Ibhola A lifaka ngaphakathi kwesilinda C lithinta phezulu, phansi, nohlangothi ngqo. Ake sithi ubukhulu bezitsha abunakwa futhi akukho manzi achitheka. Osayizi bezitsha batshelwa futhi esinyathelweni ngasinye salo msebenzi.
z-m-17-03.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa okuqinisekile nokungumcabango ngalokho owaziyo manje
z-m-17-03.thinking.2: Ukuqaphela uma wenza isiphetho esibanzi ngokulinganisa okukodwa
z-m-17-03.prereq.0: Ivolumu yesilinda (indawo yesisekelo × ukuphakama), nokuthi ivolumu yekhoni enesisekelo nokuphakama okufanayo ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yesilinda
z-m-17-03.prereq.1: Awudingi ukwazi ifomula yevolumu yebhola (itholakala kulo msebenzi)
z-m-17-03.s.s1.prompt: Idatha embulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha lokho ocabanga ukuthi kufaneleka kakhulu ngalokho okwaziwayo manje kuphela, futhi uma idatha entsha ifika, qhubeka noma ulungise isinqumo sakho.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, hlukanisa lokho ongakusho ngokuqinisekile ngalokho okwaziwayo kuze kube manje kuphela nalokho okungumcabango nje.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.hint.1: Uthatha isilinda C njengesithenjwa, dweba noma ucabange izingxenye ibhola A nekhoni B ezithatha, bese uziqhathanisa.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Kunezitsha ezintathu. A simise okwebhola esinoradiyasi engu-3 cm, B simise okwekhoni esinoradiyasi yesisekelo engu-3 cm nokuphakama okungu-6 cm, no-C simise okwesilinda esinoradiyasi yesisekelo engu-3 cm nokuphakama okungu-6 cm. Ibhola A lifaka ngaphakathi kwesilinda C lithinta phezulu, phansi, nohlangothi ngqo. Ubukhulu bezitsha abunakwa futhi akukho manzi achitheka. Ivolumu yekhoni enesisekelo nokuphakama okufanayo ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yevolumu yesilinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uzama ukugcwalisa A ngokuphelele ngokugcwalisa B ngamanzi uwathele ku-A, uphinda lokho. Ngaphambi kokubala, ucabanga ukuthi kudingeka ukuthela izikhathi ezingaki ukuze A igcwale?
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ibhola A lifaka ngaphakathi kwesilinda C futhi kukhona isikhala esingenalutho eduze namakhona, ngakho ungasho ukuthi kudinga ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezingu-3 zika-B, inani eligcwalisa u-C. Awukwazi okwamanje ukwazi ngqo ukuthi izikhathi ezingaki.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kubonakala A izogcwala ngemva kokuthela cishe izikhathi ezi-3, ngaphandle kokushoda
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi ibhola ligcwalisa isilinda ngokuphelele. Cabanga izingxenye ezingenalutho phakathi kwebhola namakhona esilinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubonakala ukuthela ngaphezu kwesikhathi esingu-1 nangaphansi kwezikhathi ezingu-3 kuzokwanela
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi kungaphezu kwesitsha esisodwa sekhoni kodwa kungekho kangako njengesilinda. Sho ukuthi ukuqhathanisa okusekela lokhu kuyini.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kubonakala ngisho nokuthela isikhathi esingu-1 kwanele ukugcwalisa
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uthathe ibhola nekhoni njengosayizi ofanayo. Qhathanisa ingxenye ngayinye ethatha ngaphakathi kwesilinda.

z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi izinga liyaziwa kodwa inani eliqondile lezikhathi lidinga ukubala noma ukulinganisa.

z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngokulinganisa, A ingu-2 izikhathi ze-B nesilinda C singu-3 izikhathi ze-B. Ngakho A ingxenye emibili kwezintathu ka-C. Ungahlola nangokubala. B ingu-18π, A ingu-36π, no-C ingu-54π cm³. Kodwa, ukusho ukuthi ukulinganisa okukodwa kusebenza kuwo wonke osayizi, udinga ukuhlola nakwabanye osayizi.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: A ingu-2 izikhathi ze-B no-C ingu-3 izikhathi ze-B, ngakho A ingxenye emibili kwezintathu ka-C
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uxhumanise umphumela wokulinganisa nobudlelwano phakathi kwesilinda nekhoni futhi wafunda ngisho nobudlelwano phakathi kwebhola nesilinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A iyingxenye ka-C, ngoba ibhola lifaka isilinda ngqo
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ube nomuzwa wokuthi njengoba ibhola lifaka isilinda ngqo, kungaba yisigamu. Qhathanisa nokuthi ekulinganiseni A ingu-2 izikhathi ze-B no-C ingu-3 izikhathi ze-B.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Singazi kuphela ukuthi A ingu-2 izikhathi ze-B futhi asikwazi ukwazi ubudlelwano no-C
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Awusebenzisanga ubudlelwano phakathi kwesilinda nekhoni obunikezwe kanye nokulinganisa. Xhuma amaqiniso amabili.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Silinganise icala elilodwa kuphela, ngakho kufanele sihlole ngokwehlukana ukuthi kuyafana yini kwabanye osayizi
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Lona ngumbono onakekile ngokwenza isiphetho esibanzi ngokulinganisa okukodwa. Nalesi sinqumo, ungasho nobudlelwano osanda kububona manje.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Manje senza izitsha ngobude bonke buphindwe kabili. A' libhola elinoradiyasi engu-6 cm, no-C' isilinda esinoradiyasi yesisekelo engu-6 cm nokuphakama okungu-12 cm. A' nalo lifaka ngqo ngaphakathi kuka-C'.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ivolumu yesilinda C' ngu-π×6²×12 = 432π, okuyi-8 izikhathi ze-54π ka-C. A' ingxenye emibili kwezintathu ka-C', ngakho 288π, futhi A ingu-36π, ngakho izikhathi ezi-8. Uma ubude buphindwa kabili, ububanzi, ukujula, nokuphakama konke kuphindeka kabili, ngakho ivolumu iba 2×2×2 = izikhathi ezi-8.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi uma ubude buphindeka kabili, ivolumu nayo iphindeka kabili. Qhathanisa ngqo amavolumu ezilinda C' no-C.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Leli yinani lokuphindaphinda u-2 kabili, njengendawo. Ngevolumu, zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu, ububanzi, ukujula, nokuphakama, ziyabandakanyeka.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lokhu kucabangile ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu ziphindeka kabili.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Leli yinani lokuphindaphinda u-2 kane. Hlola ukuthi udinga ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi ezingaki.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ubungakwazi ukusho kuphela izinga 'ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezingu-3,' ekulinganiseni wafunda ubudlelwano 2 : 3, futhi ekugcineni walinganisa ukuthi ivolumu iba nkulu izikhathi ezingaki uma ubude bukhuliswa. Bheka emuva ukuthi yikuphi ukuqiniseka okukhulile noma kwancipha esinyathelweni ngasinye nokuthi yibuphi ubufakazi obubangele.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.prompt: USua uthe, "Ibhola lifaka ngqo esilindeni, ngakho ivolumu yebhola kumele ibe yisigamu sevolumu yesilinda." Hlola ukuthi lokhu kulungile yini usebenzisa imiphumela yokulinganisa engenhla njengobufakazi, futhi uma kungalungile, bhala ukuthi kufanele kulungiswe kanjani.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ngemiphumela yokulinganisa, bhala umugqa owodwa ngamunye wobudlelwano buka-A, B, no-C ngokuthi 'izikhathi ezingaki.'
z-m-17-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuthi 'isigamu' uSua akhulume ngaso silingana nezitsha ezingaki zika-B bese uqhathanisa nomphumela wokulinganisa.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uyisekele impendulo yakho ezimpumeleni zokulinganisa (A ingu-2 izikhathi ze-B, C ingu-3 izikhathi ze-B)?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise ingxenye yomcabango kaSua elungile (ibhola lincane kunesilinda) neyingxenye engalungile (isigamu)?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubhale ngokucacile ngezinombolo isitatimende esilungisiwe (isibonelo, ingxenye)?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.model.0: Akulungile. Ukuthela B kabili kugcwalisa A, futhi C ithatha izikhathi ezingu-3 zika-B, ngakho A ingxenye emibili kwezintathu ka-C. Kulungile ukuthi ibhola lincane kunesilinda, kodwa likhulu kakhulu kunesigamu.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.model.1: A ingu-36π no-C ingu-54π cm³, ngakho A÷C = 2/3. Noma ibhola lifaka isilinda ngqo, amakhona angenalutho, ngakho alligcwali, kodwa ligcwalisa izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu, hhayi isigamu. Umcabango kaSua udinga ukulungiswa.

z-m-17-06.title: Uma isamba semilinganiselo ehlobene siphuma ngu-0.99, ingabe itafula alilungile?
z-m-17-06.goal: Funda ukuthi ungahlola kanjani ukuthi igebe esambeni semvamisa ehlobene kusuka ku-1 liyimbangela yokuzungeza noma iphutha langempela, buyekeza isahlulelo nokuqiniseka ngolwazi olusha, futhi wenze wena itafula lapho isamba singalungile ngenxa yokuzungeza.
z-m-17-06.material: Etafuleni lokusabalaliswa kwemvamisa, isamba semvamisa ehlobene singu-1. Kodwa-ke, etafuleni lapho imvamisa ehlobene ibhalwe izungeziwe, isamba singahluka kancane ku-1. Kulo msebenzi, imvamisa ehlobene ibhalwe izungezwe endaweni yamadesimali amabili.
z-m-17-06.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza isahlulelo nokuqiniseka ukuze kufane nolwazi olusha
z-m-17-06.prereq.1: Imvamisa ehlobene = imvamisa yeklasi ÷ imvamisa iyonke
z-m-17-06.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bhala ngokwehlukana lokho osuke wakuhlola nalokho ongakakuhloli.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenza ukuthi umehluko owenziwe ukuzungeza inani elilodwa ungabaningi kangakanani usayizi wegebe esambeni.

z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kungase kube nephutha lokubala, ngakho bala futhi imvamisa nemvamisa ehlobene bese uhlola
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lesi yisimilo sokuhlola futhi ingxenye oyingabazayo. Lokho ozokuhlulela ngemva kokuhlola yikho okubalulekile.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Umehluko ungase uvele ekuzungezeni, ngakho hlola amanani ngqo
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi yisimilo sokugcina kuvulekile ukuthi kungase kungabi nembangela eyodwa kuphela nokuhlola.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Isamba semvamisa ehlobene kumele sibe ngu-1, ngakho leli tafula, elingeyona u-1, litafula elingalungile
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Isici sokuthi isamba singu-1 sibhekisela emanani ngaphambi kokuzungeza. Sebenza ukuthi sisebenza njengoba sinjalo emanani anqunyiwe afike endaweni yamadesimali amabili.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Umehluko we-0.01 mncane kakhulu, ngakho bhala kabusha isamba njenge-1.00 ngaphandle kokuhlola
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uma ulungisa ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi kungani ngisho umehluko omncane uvele, awukwazi ukuhlukanisa iphutha langempela nomehluko wokuzungeza.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Lapho kuhlolwa, imvamisa yayingu-10, 10, 10, futhi isamba sayo salingana nesamba sabafundi abangu-30. Imvamisa ehlobene ngayinye ingu-10÷30 = 0.3333..., futhi yabhalwa izungeziwe endaweni yamadesimali amabili njengo-0.33. Konke okungezansi kwendawo yesithathu yedesimali kwalahlwa.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ubona lo mphumela wokuhlola, yisiphi isahlulelo esifaneleka kakhulu ngalelitafula?
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma unqamula u-0.3333... endaweni yesithathu yedesimali, wonke amanani amathathu aba mancane kancane, ngakho isamba singu-0.99. Lolu hlobo lomehluko lungenxa yokuzungeza, hhayi ngoba itafula alilungile. Kukhona nendlela yokulungisa inani ukwenza isamba sibe ngu-1, kodwa kulokho kumele usho ukuthi ulungisile.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ukubala kulungile. Isamba saba ngu-0.99 ngenxa yomehluko wokulahla konke okungezansi kwendawo yesithathu yedesimali
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wahlulela ngokuxhumanisa umphumela wokuhlola ukubala nomthelela wokuzungeza.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Noma ukubala kulungile, uma isamba singesona u-1 litafula elingalungile, ngakho imvamisa kumele isethwe futhi
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukubone njengokungalungile nakuba ukubala kulungile. Cabanga ukuthi uthola ini uma unqamula u-0.3333... futhi uwengeza kathathu.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ukubala kulungile. Ungabhala inani elilodwa njengo-0.34 ukwenza isamba sibe ngu-1, kodwa sho ukuthi ulungisile
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ucabange ngeqiniso lokuthi kukhona indlela yokwenza isamba sifanele nokuthi kumele usho lokho ngaleso sikhathi.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Shintsha imvamisa ibe yinto efana no-10, 10, 11 ukuze isamba sisondele ku-1
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Imvamisa umphumela wokubala abafundi. Akumele ushintshe idatha ukwenza isamba setafula sifane.

z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yisiphi isahlulelo esifaneleka kakhulu ngesamba esingu-1.10 kuleli tafula?

z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukubone njengesizathu esifanayo nesetafula langaphambilini. Qhathanisa ukuthi lo mehluko unosayizi ofanayo nomehluko wangaphambilini yini.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kunezigaba ezine, ngakho nje umehluko wokuzungeza ungenza isamba sibe ngu-1.10
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kulungile ukuthi amaphutha okuzungeza angaqongelela esambeni. Kodwa qhathanisa nokuthi umehluko ovela inani elilodwa mncane kangakanani.
z-m-17-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Umehluko wokuzungeza awukwazi ukunika u-0.10 nhlobo, ngakho hlola ukuthi isamba semvamisa singu-30 yini

z-m-17-01.goal: Hlulela ukuthi isimo sokuthi ubude be-arc buyalingana kuphela sinquma indawo ye-sector yini, hlola ngokwenza izibonelo ezinama-radius ahlukile, bese uchaza ukuthi ubude be-arc nendawo kushintsha kanjani ngokwehlukana nge-radius kanye ne-engeli ephakathi.

I-radius ne-engeli ephakathi zingakhethwa ngokuhlukile kuyo yonke into yokuhlobisa. (π yi-pi, futhi ukujiya kwephepha ne-ribbon akunakwa. I-engeli ephakathi inkulu kuno-0° futhi incane kuno-360°.)

z-m-17-02.title: Ukuthola umugqa ongalungile esixazululweni se-engeli eyenziwa izikhombi zewashi
z-m-17-02.topic: Usayizi wama-engeli namayunithi: i-engeli eyenziwa izikhombi zewashi
z-m-17-02.goal: Thola futhi ulungise umugqa ongalungile esixazululweni se-engeli eyenziwa izikhombi zewashi, bese uchaza ukuthi uma zombili izikhombi zihamba, indawo yesikhombi ngasinye kumele isethwe ngokwehlukana ukuze ihambisane nesikhathi.
z-m-17-02.material:
Ebusweni bewashi le-analog, izinombolo ezingu-12 zibekwe ngezikhawu ezilinganayo, futhi ama-engeli alinganiswa ngokuya ngokwewashi kusukela esiqondisweni se-12 o'clock. Iwashi liyalunga futhi isikhombi ngasinye siphenduka ngesilinganiso esimisiwe. Isikhombi samahora senza ukujika kanye emahoreni angu-12, futhi isikhombi semizuzu senza ukujika kanye emizuzwini engu-60. U-Minjae uzame ukuthola i-engeli eyenziwa isikhombi samahora nesikhombi semizuzu ngo-3:20 (encane phakathi kwama-engeli amabili) futhi wasixazulula kanje.
1) Ukujika okugcwele kwewashi kungu-360° futhi kunezinombolo ezingu-12, ngakho isikhala sinombolo esisodwa singu-30°.
2) Isikhombi semizuzu senza ukujika kanye emizuzwini engu-60, ngakho siya ku-6° umzuzu ngamunye, futhi emizuzwini engu-20 singu-120° kusuka esiqondisweni se-12 o'clock.
3) Isikhombi samahora sikhomba ku-3, ngakho singu-90° kusuka esiqondisweni se-12 o'clock.
4) I-engeli phakathi kwezikhombi ezimbili ingu-120° − 90° = 30°.
5) Ngakho i-engeli eyenziwa isikhombi samahora nesikhombi semizuzu ngo-3:20 ingu-30°.
